title: ID0447143-DC/Si-D/FR-[Y2/P7 312547889/08] Charging Issue
description:
Reported issue: Charging Issue
Solution: NA
yyyy-mm-dd:NA
When you charge at one charging point, the other charging point is unavailable. Only one person can charge at the same time.
The load distribution setting must have been changed during an update.
Can you make both charging points usable at the same time?

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0447143-DC/Si-D/FR-[Y2/P7 312547889/08] Charging Issue CRM:02678000271
additional_info.body:
Good evening Mr. Raymond,
I am reaching out from the
Technical support
team in regards of ticket
ID0447143.
The ticket has been opened for charger
Y2/P7 312547889/08
, which on 28.08.2025 showed outlet DC1 as "connected", while no vehicle was physically connected to it.
I checked the charger remotely, and the outlet was showing an incorrect pilot state B after ending a charging session on 27.08.2025. I see that the charger controller was restarted then on 30.08.2025, and the issue solved itself. Since then, the outlet DC1 performed successful charging sessions.
This is the status of the charger at the moment:
For future occurrences, I would suggest to reboot the charger if an outlet shows "connected" with no real EV there. I also checked and no FW update was performed recently on the charger, so there is no connection with a different setting coming from an update.
Since this issue was a one-time occurrence, and it solved itself by rebooting the charger (or just the charger controller), I will proceed to close this ticket.
If you need any further assistance, please do reach back out to us by submitting a new request at
www.siemens.com/emobility-service-request
Kindly note that email responses to closed tickets are not monitored.
With kind regards,
